ideas.title_en: Deterministic detector for AI-generated design tells
ideas.title_ar: كاشف حتمي لعلامات التصميم المولّد بالذكاء الاصطناعي
ideas.mechanism: Scan HTML/CSS with fixed rules (one font for everything, purple-to-blue gradients, cards nested in cards, grey text on coloured backgrounds, icon tile above every heading, emoji bullets, everything centred, one radius everywhere, low contrast) and report each hit with a fix, no model needed.

ideas.title_en: Durable product truth kept apart from per-surface visual direction
ideas.title_ar: حقيقة المنتج الثابتة منفصلة عن الاتجاه البصري لكل شاشة
ideas.mechanism: Record audience, purpose, constraints, voice and evidence once (product card); choose visual direction per surface later and record the visual system separately, so a style change never rewrites the facts.

ideas.title_en: The agent cannot watch the video: give it eyes
ideas.title_ar: الوكيل لا يشاهد الفيديو: أعطه عيونًا
ideas.mechanism: Turn a render into things a text model can read: a contact strip of evenly spaced frames, an onion-skin blend that shows path and easing, a per-second motion-energy timeline that flags frozen stretches, and loudness, peak, clipping and silence per segment.

ideas.title_en: Seekable, deterministic HTML-to-video with lint, preview, render
ideas.title_ar: فيديو حتمي من HTML قابل للتقديم بالزمن: فحص ثم معاينة ثم رندر
ideas.mechanism: Every animation is a function of time so any frame can be rendered alone; the loop is plan, write, lint, preview, render.

ideas.title_en: Reuse-first ladder: write only what the task needs
ideas.title_ar: سلّم إعادة الاستخدام: اكتب فقط ما تحتاجه المهمة
ideas.mechanism: Before writing code climb: existing project code, then platform-native feature, then an installed library, then new code; never cut validation, error handling, security or accessibility to get smaller.

ideas.title_en: Review the touched code, not only the diff; four-part findings
ideas.title_ar: راجع الكود المتأثر لا الفرق فقط؛ ملاحظة من أربعة أجزاء
ideas.mechanism: Each finding states what the code does, what goes wrong, how to fix it, and what happens if not fixed; read the callers and callees of the change.

ideas.title_en: Conclusion-first explainer page with numbered sources
ideas.title_ar: صفحة شرح تبدأ بالخلاصة مع مصادر مرقمة
ideas.mechanism: Answer first, then one panel per question; diagrams sit beside the steps that walk through them; every claim cites a numbered source.

ideas.title_en: Explain an idea by building a working object whose mechanism is the concept
ideas.title_ar: اشرح الفكرة ببناء شيء يعمل وآليته هي الفكرة نفسها
ideas.mechanism: Invent a physical machine whose working is the concept (a cache becomes a pin-tumbler lock); every number shown comes from the same small model that moves the parts.

ideas.title_en: Independent judge and a simulated day of real requests
ideas.title_ar: حكم مستقل ويوم محاكاة من طلبات حقيقية
ideas.mechanism: Audit an agent by sending it a realistic day of requests, including ones that push past its role, and grading each reply with a judge that is not the agent itself (other persona or provider).

ideas.title_en: Closed learning loop: skills created and improved from experience
ideas.title_ar: حلقة تعلم مغلقة: مهارات تُبنى وتتحسن من التجربة
ideas.mechanism: After a complex task, save the working procedure as a reusable recipe; recall it next time; improve it with each use.

ideas.title_en: Context economy: keep raw tool output out of the conversation
ideas.title_ar: اقتصاد السياق: أبقِ مخرجات الأدوات الخام خارج المحادثة
ideas.mechanism: Large outputs (logs, page snapshots, JSON) are written to files and summarised by a script; only the summary and the path enter the context; analysis is done in code, not by reading.

ideas.title_en: Spec before code, small sign-offs, plans for a reader with no context
ideas.title_ar: المواصفة قبل الكود، موافقات صغيرة، خطة لقارئ بلا سياق
ideas.mechanism: Tease out the spec, show it in short chunks, then a plan explicit enough for a junior with no project context, then build slice by slice with tests as proof.
lives_in: PROTOCOL.md (request card, plans A/B/C, one-word answers)

ideas.title_en: Brand onboarding from a URL
ideas.title_ar: التقاط هوية العلامة من رابط
ideas.mechanism: Pull palette and fonts from the client's site once, then every diagram or page uses them.
lives_in: scripts/brand_tokens.py (palette from an SVG logo; no URL crawl yet)

ideas.title_ar: مكتبة لقطات حقيقية بدل تحريك الصور الثابتة، مع دفتر تكلفة لكل فيلم
ideas.mechanism: Build a corpus from free stock and open archives, retrieve real motion clips, cut them on a timeline; record the spend of every generated asset.

ideas.title_en: Long video to platform-ready shorts with captions, cover and post copy
ideas.title_ar: فيديو طويل إلى مقاطع قصيرة جاهزة للمنصات مع ترجمة وغلاف ونص منشور
ideas.mechanism: One link in; detect highlight segments, reframe to the platform, page the subtitles, make the cover and the caption per platform.

ideas.title_en: Art-style motion grammar: styles x explainer grammars x parametric snippets
ideas.title_ar: قواعد موشن للأساليب الفنية: أساليب × قواعد شرح × مقاطع معلمية
ideas.mechanism: Keep a library of art styles, a few explainer grammars and parametric snippets; recompose for each subject instead of reusing one composition.

ideas.title_en: Reusable node workflows saved as versioned templates with run records
ideas.title_ar: سير عمل عقدي قابل لإعادة الاستخدام كقوالب بإصدارات وسجل تشغيل
ideas.mechanism: Connect processing and generation as editable nodes; save a working chain as a template version; rebind new inputs and keep the chain.

ideas.title_en: Text to parametric CAD
ideas.title_ar: من النص إلى تصميم CAD معلمي
ideas.mechanism: The agent writes a parametric feature timeline (sketch, constrain, extrude) rather than a mesh, so dimensions stay editable.

ideas.title_en: Fully local voice suite: cloning, dubbing, dictation
ideas.title_ar: حزمة صوت محلية بالكامل: استنساخ ودبلجة وإملاء

ideas.title_en: Agent teams defined as data and run in parallel
ideas.title_ar: فرق وكلاء معرّفة كبيانات وتعمل بالتوازي
ideas.mechanism: Describe the team (roles, inputs, outputs) in a file, boot it, and merge the results in one verify step.

ideas.title_en: Codebase knowledge graph for agents
ideas.title_ar: رسم معرفي للكود من أجل الوكلاء
ideas.mechanism: Index code, docs and schemas into a queryable graph so the agent asks for callers and impact instead of reading files.

ideas.title_en: Remove signs of AI-generated writing
ideas.title_ar: إزالة علامات الكتابة المولّدة
ideas.mechanism: A list of tells (stock phrases, rule-of-three, em-dash habits, vague intensifiers) checked and rewritten.

ideas.title_en: Domain skill packs (marketing, science) as checklists with gates
ideas.title_ar: حزم مهارات مجالية (تسويق، علوم) كقوائم بوابات
ideas.mechanism: Each domain skill is a short procedure with its own quality gate (e.g. a landing page passes CRO checks before copy is final).

ideas.title_ar: شريط التكلفة: الرموز والوقت والإنفاق لكل مهمة
ideas.mechanism: Display what the current task cost and how often existing code was reused, so waste is visible while working.
